|notes=The set was released 21 November 2003. The complete first sheet remains unlocated. The comparison dates each surviving issuer text. [https://web.archive.org/web/20031202154611id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm Players Committee release announcement]. The initial surviving text protects your boosted Force drain against the opponent and forbids opposing movement throughout your turn while a captive is frozen. The earlier issuer gallery face keeps the full-turn timing and omits the protection. The dated 14 September 2007 replacement limits the prohibition to your battle phase. The earlier face’s 27 November capture dates the surviving copy.
